answer: Locks are recorded in thread, expire in fable, and kernel lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 79 aliases as a result needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3744 identities would post 4195 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
